name: ZeroClaw
description: Agent runtime shipped as a single Rust binary that connects LLM providers to 30+ chat channels and can run as a service.
whatItDoes: Runs a configurable personal or team agent that talks through channels such as Discord and Telegram. It can be kept running in the background as a system service.
howItWorks: A quickstart command picks a provider and writes a working config. Agents are defined as named entries in that config and started interactively or registered with systemd, launchctl or Windows Service.

requirements.name: LLM provider
requirements.description: Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama or about twenty others

models: Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama and roughly 20 other providers
